messages:
Casey: Quick thread to lock customer-facing artifacts for the Apr 22 outage. We need: short statuspage blurb, 72h public summary, enterprise briefing template, and a clear RCA access policy. Also assign owners and add to action tracker.

Joelle: I'll draft the 1-2 line statuspage blurb and push to staging. Aim: non-technical, neutral tone. ETA staging preview: 2024-04-25 17:30 PT.

Arun: I'll take the 72h public summary (public). I'll include timeline, impact buckets, mitigation, and a short "recurrence note" referencing KV cache evictions without deep details. ETA: 2024-04-26 17:00 PT.

Samir: I'll prepare enterprise templates and a suggested CS script for account briefings. Also propose offering a voluntary private briefing for materially impacted customers. ETA: 2024-04-26 COB.

Joelle: Draft statuspage copy: 
"Status: Partial service disruption — Resolved. Between 03:12 and 03:42 UTC some requests to the embeddings endpoint experienced elevated latency and errors for some requests. We mitigated the issue and service is operating normally. A public summary will be posted within 72 hours."

Casey: Good. For RCA access policy I want a single sentence that covers public summary + request flow + NDA possibility. Keep it short.

Samir: Proposed sentence: "A redacted summary is available publicly; verified impacted customers may request a detailed RCA via Support. Sensitive information may be shared under NDA at Legal's discretion"

LegalBot: Minor suggestion: change "verified impacted customers" to "verified customers who experienced material impact" to reduce ambiguity.

Joelle: Updated: "A redacted summary is available publicly; customers who experienced material impact may request a detailed RCA via Support. Sensitive information may be shared under NDA at Legal's discretion." Pushing to staging once Arun confirms 72h hooks.

Arun: I'll add a short paragraph in the 72h summary linking to Support and describing what customers can expect in a private briefing (high level findings, timeline, mitigations). Will flag anything that Legal should redact.

Casey: Recurrence follow-up: this aligns with the quarterly KV cache eviction spikes. Assign SRE owner and a monitoring/mitigation task.

incident-bot: Action ITEM-8092 created and assigned to Mateo (Platform SRE): investigate recurring KV cache evictions and propose mitigations by 2024-05-06. Link: https://tracker.redwood.example/ITEM-8092

Casey: Action list to add to tracker: statuspage copy (Joelle) -> publish 2024-04-25 18:00 PT; 72h public summary (Arun) -> 2024-04-26 17:00 PT; enterprise templates & briefings (Samir) -> 2024-04-26 COB; SRE recurrence task -> Mateo -> 2024-05-06; legal review of RCA wording -> Legal -> 2024-04-28.

Joelle: Quick sync tomorrow 10:30 PT to approve final text. :calendar:

incident-bot: Reminder scheduled for 1834593600 (tomorrow 10:30 PT).
